text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(—It felt as though time itself had slowed 
down.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ――Oooooohhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ngh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (At this rate... ngh!!)!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And the moment those feelings reached 
their absolute peak, I unmistakably heard 
that "sound"—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win... I want to win, I want to 
win! Against Yaeno-san, against Chiyono 
O-san—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Right now," right here, I want to win!!!
(――SHATTERRR!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The sound of glass shattering...? Did my 
leg... break...?)'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (No, that's not it... This is—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAARGH!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(That's the sound of me—surpassing my 
limits, "right now"...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan! It's Mejiro Ardan!! The 
young lady of the Mejiro family conquers 
the Japanese Derby! Mejiro Ardan crosses 
the finish line!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It was a wonderful race. Everyone was... 
shining so brightly.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Mejiro Ardan! You were 
insanely cool--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the greatest race everrr!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I had no idea...! To think that such a 
dazzling realm existed in the middle of a 
race...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And... reaching that realm beyond my 
limits... was by no means something I 
achieved on my own...――)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ――Ardan-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Your running, your spirit, your thirst 
for victory... became the guiding light 
that unlocked the gates to my closed-off 
limits—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...That was amazing. Ardan-san's running, 
that is..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Truly... truly! Congratulations!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno-san—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...It is my complete defeat. However—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I have no intention of letting things end 
like this. Next time... I will be the one 
who takes the victory."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm honored to hear you say that. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I have no intention of yielding victory 
next time either. I shall face you with 
everything I have."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —That's the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer—
choice_data_list: You've etched your name into history.
You've etched your name into history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And that goes for... you too, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A Derby Umamusume and a Derby Trainer... 
Our journey up to this "now" has borne 
fruit here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Me too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan!! You ran every bit as 
brilliantly as Mejiro Ramonu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (That's right... up until "now," I've—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I completely forgot... about my 
sister...—)

With the thunderous applause and cheers 
behind us, as I was heading back to the 
waiting room with Mejiro Ardan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—I had a strange experience during today's 
race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...As the finish line drew near, an 
unknown sensation welled up inside me, as 
if the entire world were being enveloped 
in silence—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of it all, the only things 
that came through with crystal clarity 
were the heartbeats and galloping 
footfalls of Chiyono O and Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"And drawn by that rhythm, I opened the 
gates of my own limits and was able to 
step into a new domain..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The response in that moment... The 
conviction that even greater heights lie 
ahead still lingers in these hands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Besides... even I was surprised, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Until just a moment ago, it seems... I 
had forgotten my goal... of surpassing my 
sister's brilliance."
choice_data_list:
...That just shows how fiercely you 
competed with your rival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: With my rival, giving it everything—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah... So that was the case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The two of you are my irreplaceable 
friends... and rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It was only because I competed with 
everything I had against them—enough to 
make me forget Sister's aurora—that...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because they competed with 
everything they had—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Today... I was able to shine even 
brighter...!!

"For Mejiro Ardan, who has pursued her own 
running and her own unique 'now,' today's 
realization will surely be immense."
I, too... was able to feel certain of it.

And so, my journey with Mejiro Ardan 
stepped into a new domain...!
